notes.themes: Synergy hypotheses from FRA guides, recorded 2026-11-02 for testing (tools/fit_themes.py); not applied by the engine. Patterns match lower-cased oracle text.

surveil.payoff: whenever you scry or surveil|scried or surveilled|whenever you surveil|surveilled this turn
surveil.claim: WU surveil: Peer Review, Fatehold Chronologist, Semester Foreseer and every empower card feed Prudent Fateseer, Surveillance Phantasm, Desperate Futurescribe, Denzilore Fatehold.
video_claims: Videos add Proctor of Potential, Denzilore Fatehold, Diviner of Victory, Fatehold Charm, Eye of Jace; WU named one of the strongest decks because its cards pull the same way.

jace.payoff: control a jace|jace tokens? you control|loyalty abilit|planeswalkers? you control|another planeswalker
jace.claim: UG empower: Jace tokens grow into card draw; Way of the Mind Sculptor, Tam, Kiora of Salt and Sand and Mind Meanderer pay off; Arcane Amphisbaena, Keeper of the Quiet Hour, Mindseeker Oculus enable.
video_claims: Videos add Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes, Sanctum Lurker, Repurposed Enforcer, Theorist's Sanctum, Jace's Machinations, Tam's Resistance; Kiora of Salt and Sand an 'upside trap'.

graveyard.payoff: threshold|seven or more cards in your graveyard|cards in your graveyard|from your graveyard|flashback
graveyard.claim: UB threshold / BG recursion: Omit Variables, Void Extrapolator, Primal Witchstalker fill the graveyard for Recursive Recruitment, Theoretical Necromancer, Null Summoner, Rewrite Regrets.
video_claims: Videos: Theorix Metamage/Charm, Void Extrapolator, Paradox Shaper mill via the prepared spell; Recursive Recruitment can be splashed in BG; Hapatra wants big cards (landcyclers are MV 6) in the graveyard; Paradox Shaper does not share a deck with threshold.

noncombat.enabler: deals? \d+ damage to (target|each) opponent|damage to each opponent|vicious verse
noncombat.claim: BR pings: Stingerquill Voxmancer (Vicious Verse), Screeching Soulbreaker, Hallway Heckler enable Grim Repriser, Master of Barbs, Massacre Girl, Command the Stage.
video_claims: Videos: Master of Barbs with Ingris Stingerquill 'game over'; cast payoffs before enablers; hosts trust BR least.

lifegain.payoff: whenever you gain life|if you gained life
lifegain.claim: WG lifegain: Blessed Ghoul, Medic's Kitesail, Seed Suture creatures trigger Bloombrute, Titanbones, Kwia Vigorbloom, Unflinching Hortimancer, Lyra.
video_claims: Videos: Germinate Recruits (X 2/2s, X = life gained this turn), Ajani Resolute 'dream' payoff; the WG prepared spell gains only 1; Vigorbloom Charm is the best partner.

aristocrats.enabler: create (a|an|two|three|x) [^.]*creature token|sacrifice|return this card from your graveyard|exile this card from your graveyard
aristocrats.payoff: whenever (another|a) (nontoken )?creature( or planeswalker)? you control dies|sacrifice another creature|sacrifice a creature|creatures? died this turn|each player sacrifices
aristocrats.claim: WB sacrifice / recursion: recursive bodies (Gallia, Blessed Ghoul, Campus Crier) and token makers feed death payoffs (Edgar, Bloodline Recollector, Massacre Girl, Garruk Veiled Butcher).
video_claims: Videos: Bloodline Recollector and Darklight Phoenix need 3+ / 2+ deaths a turn; Twisted Fates wants a big board, which fights Edgar's sacrifice plan.

spells.payoff: prowess|whenever you cast a noncreature spell|whenever you cast an instant or sorcery
spells.claim: UR/BR spells: noncreature spells trigger prowess creatures, Saheeli Jewel of Avishkar, Chandra's Emberling, Traxos.

counters.claim: WR counters: Mabel, Yoshimaru, Warrior's Blades, Winter Team Player.
video_claims: Videos: Vigorbloom Vanguard (counters give vigilance), Mabel, Warrior's Blades (discount doubted).

ramp.enabler: heartwood token|add \{|landcycling|search your library for a basic land
ramp.claim: RG ramp: Heartwood makers (Konstrari Improviser, Heartwood Crafter, Woodwork Prodigy) cast Craftwork Crusher, Aerid Konstrari, Ruric Thar early.
video_claims: Videos: Craftwork Crusher reached turn 6-7 through Heartwood; Murmuring Volume as fixing for a black splash.

etb.claim: BG: Ferocity of the Hunt (and Rescue Girl in WB) reuse enters-the-battlefield creatures like Rank Rat, Arcane Amphisbaena, Primal Witchstalker.
video_claims: Videos: Ferocity of the Hunt best on tramplers, first strikers and enters-the-battlefield creatures; Flickering Hound graded D.

artifacts.payoff: artifacts? you control|for each artifact|number of artifacts|enchant artifact|artifact tokens? would be created
artifacts.claim: RG/UR artifacts: Heartwood, Thopter and Treasure makers feed Craterclaw Colossus (+X per artifact, 'medium to strong with one artifact'), Puppet Crafting (wants 6-7 artifacts or enchantments), Draconic Visitor, Saheeli's thopters.

prepared.enabler: enters prepared|becomes prepared|each creature you control becomes prepared
prepared.payoff: prepared spell|whenever you cast a copy|becomes prepared
prepared.claim: Prepared copies: Codie, Ravenous Codex copies prepared spells; Draconic Visitor with the self-preparing RG uncommon; Hexhaven Dueling Arena re-prepares (rated F).

flashback.payoff: flashback|instant or sorcery card in your graveyard|instant and sorcery cards? in your graveyard
flashback.claim: UR/UB spell recursion: Stingcaster Mage needs many castable instants and sorceries (counterspells and attack-only removal do not count); Twinned Vision and Cryotheory flashback cards.

millcount.claim: Self-mill payoffs counting the graveyard: Cruel Calculations (draw X milled this turn), Tarmogoyf, Dark Matter Manipulator; decking is a real risk with Liliana the Repentant.
